title: different BG readings
symptom: The user is using xDrip+ with MiaoMiao and the readings from the app are different from the official Libre scanner. They ask if there is a way to make xDrip+ use the same algorithm as the official Libre scanner and which readings are more accurate.
fix: To get results similar to the scanner, use the LibreOOPAlgorithm as described in the linked repository. The thread does not state a specific configuration change within xDrip.
evidence_quote: To get results similar to the scanner, please see https://github.com/tzachi-dar/LibreOOPAlgorithm
